query: 供应商申诉机制 供应商申诉机制 衡量企业为供应商提供的正式沟通与举报渠道。重点考察申诉渠道的独立性、匿名保护能力、反报复政策、处理时限以及重大争议的升级处理机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：设有独立的第三方举报平台或由审计/合规部门直管的匿名渠道；具备书面的《供应商反报复政策》；明确了申诉处理的时限（如 15 个工作日内给予实质性答复）；并有高级管理层参与的争议调解与升级路径。 • 1分（合格）：提供了采购部门外的申诉联系方式（如廉洁邮箱、热线），有基础的受理与记录流程，但缺乏第三方独立性、具体的处理时限承诺或系统性的反报复保护细则。 • 0分（不合格）：无针对供应商的正式申诉渠道披露，或仅提供采购员个人联系方式。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：申诉机制覆盖 >80% 的供应商（按采购额或数量计），且在供应商系统（SRM）、合同附件或年度供应商大会中进行了明确告知。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅核心供应商知晓该渠道，或未披露具体告知与覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 供应商申诉机制 供应商举报 供应商诉说渠道 供应商反报复 采购廉洁热线 供应商争议升级 SRM supplier grievance mechanism supplier whistleblowing supplier speak-up anti-retaliation for suppliers procurement integrity hotline supplier dispute escalation SRM 供应商可用的正式申诉/举报渠道有哪些？ 是否独立于采购员个人联系方式并支持匿名？ 是否有书面反报复政策与处理时限？ 重大争议如何升级到高层？ 机制覆盖多少供应商，是否告知供应商？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '供应商申诉机制'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 供应商可用的正式申诉/举报渠道有哪些？ 是否独立于采购员个人联系方式并支持匿名？ 是否有书面反报复政策与处理时限？ 重大争议如何升级到高层？ 机制覆盖多少供应商，是否告知供应商？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有员工申诉热线；仅有采购员微信/电话；仅有供应商行为准则而无申诉入口；仅有客户投诉渠道；区分：供应商申诉机制服务供应商；员工申诉服务员工；举报人保护偏内部舞弊举报；有行为准则不等于已建立供应商可及申诉渠道。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: The Group is committed to operating its business with honesty, ethics, and integrity to ensure fair competition throughout its business operations. The Group is committed to operating its business with honesty, ethics, and integrity to ensure fair competition throughout its business operations. The Group adopts a zero-tolerance attitude towards any form of corruption, including bribery, extortion, fraud, and money laundering, and has established policies, such as the 'COGO's Disciplinary and Supervisory Work System', 'COGO's Disciplinary and Supervisory Work Guidelines', 'Intendance and Audit System', 'Tendering Management Methods' etc., stating the Group's expectations and demands towards our employees and cooperation partners. In addition, the Group implements 'Implementation Rules for Separation of Incompatible Positions' to reduce the risks of corruption and fraud under the principles of horizontal check and balance and vertical restriction. Each party should perform their respective duties and responsibilities under the mutual restraint to reduce the risk of corruption and fraud.

results.text: As a leading and influential property developer in China, the Group understands the importance of developing sustainable buildings to create maximum value for stakeholders. Therefore, the Group adopts a comprehensive approach to integrate sustainable development throughout the life cycle of its properties. The Group has an explicit green procurement policy in its 'Environmental Policy', which gives priority to products and services that promote environmental sustainability, and uses international standards such as ISO14001 environmental management system certification as the standard for assessing suppliers' environmental performance. To manage social and environmental risks in the supply chain, the Group conducts regular performance assessments and two-way assessments to ensure that issues are summarized and addressed in a timely manner.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
Material Issues / Green Buildings

[Content]
As a leading and influential property developer in China, the Group understands the importance of developing sustainable buildings to create maximum value for stakeholders. Therefore, the Group adopts a comprehensive approach to integrate sustainable development throughout the life cycle of its properties. The Group has an explicit green procurement policy in its 'Environmental Policy', which gives priority to products and services that promote environmental sustainability, and uses international standards such as ISO14001 environmental management system certification as the standard for assessing suppliers' environmental performance. To manage social and environmental risks in the supply chain, the Group conducts regular performance assessments and two-way assessments to ensure that issues are summarized and addressed in a timely manner.

results.text: The '14 th Five-Year Plan for Building Energy Conservation and Green Building Development' issued by the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development sets development goals for the nation's construction industry. By 2025, all new buildings in urban areas will be fully constructed as green building. More than 50 million square meters of ultra-low energy and near-zero energy buildings will be built. Prefabricated buildings shall account for 30% of new urban buildings of the year. The installed capacity of solar photovoltaics in new buildings will be more than 50 million kilowatts. The application area of geothermal buildings will be more than 100 million square meters, and the replacement rate of renewable energy in urban buildings will reach 8%. The proportion of electricity consumption in building energy consumption is more than 55%. With these goals, a green, low-carbon, and circular construction and development mode will be formed, and a solid foundation will be laid for carbon peaking in urban and rural construction by 2030.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
Feature Stories / Feature Story 1

[Content]
The '14 th Five-Year Plan for Building Energy Conservation and Green Building Development' issued by the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development sets development goals for the nation's construction industry. By 2025, all new buildings in urban areas will be fully constructed as green building. More than 50 million square meters of ultra-low energy and near-zero energy buildings will be built. Prefabricated buildings shall account for 30% of new urban buildings of the year. The installed capacity of solar photovoltaics in new buildings will be more than 50 million kilowatts. The application area of geothermal buildings will be more than 100 million square meters, and the replacement rate of renewable energy in urban buildings will reach 8%. The proportion of electricity consumption in building energy consumption is more than 55%. With these goals, a green, low-carbon, and circular construction and development mode will be formed, and a solid foundation will be laid for carbon peaking in urban and rural construction by 2030.
